**Verdict**
- `7B.5`: mixed, leaning yes.
- I found several signs of technocratic or rule-based staffing and oversight, but no credible 2024 evidence of Trọng filling government with family, cronies, donors, or business associates. The main negative evidence is that personnel control remained party-driven, politically disruptive, and tied to anti-graft consolidation rather than open meritocracy.

**Accepted Claims**
- **Vietnam's Communist Party reprimands labour minister amid anti-graft campaign** | Reuters via MarketScreener | 2024-04-19 | [URL](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AIC-INC-16083583/news/Vietnam-s-Communist-Party-reprimands-labour-minister-amid-anti-graft-campaign-46478047/)  
  The Politburo reprimanded a senior minister over violations tied to education and vocational projects. This is evidence of policing misuse of office rather than simply rewarding loyalists.  
  `Question IDs: 7B.5, 7B.4, 7B.3`

- **Vietnam's Communist Party reprimands labour minister amid anti-graft campaign** | Reuters via MarketScreener | 2024-04-19 | [URL](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AIC-INC-16083583/news/Vietnam-s-Communist-Party-reprimands-labour-minister-amid-anti-graft-campaign-46478047/)  
  Reuters reported that the campaign had already prosecuted hundreds of officials and executives. That supports a reading of some anti-patronage discipline, though it does not prove merit-based appointment.  
  `Question IDs: 7B.5, 7B.4`

- **Top 10 Notable Events and Activities of the State Audit Office of Viet Nam in 2024** | State Audit Office of Viet Nam | 2024 | [URL](https://www.sav.gov.vn/en/Pages/detail.aspx?ItemID=268&l=News)  
  The audit office said it issued standards and organized work around power control, anti-corruption, disciplinary enforcement, and auditing. This is strong institutional evidence for professional oversight rather than pure patronage staffing.  
  `Question IDs: 7B.5, 7B.4`

- **Audit law** | State Audit Office of Viet Nam | 2024 | [URL](https://sav.gov.vn/chuyen-muc/audit-law)  
  The law frames the audit office as independent and bound to honesty, objectivity, openness, and transparency. That supports a rule-based bureaucracy rather than a family-and-friends governance model.  
  `Question IDs: 7B.5, 7B.4`

- **Vietnam hopes US will soon recognize its market economy status, FM Son says** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-03-26 | [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/vietnam-hopes-us-will-soon-recognize-its-market-economy-status-fm-son-says-3353681)  
  The foreign minister said Vietnam’s collective leadership meant the president’s resignation did not change foreign or economic policy. That is moderate evidence for an institutional, not personalistic, staffing-and-policy structure.  
  `Question IDs: 7B.5`

- **Law 41/2024/QH15 on Social Insurance** | LuatVietnam / National Assembly mirror | 2024 | [URL](https://english.luatvietnam.vn/lao-dong/law-41-2024-qh15-on-social-insurance-360809-d1.html)  
  The law turns key old-age support into a state-budget entitlement rather than discretionary patronage. This is indirect but relevant evidence of formalized public administration rather than self-serving distribution.  
  `Question IDs: 7B.5, 7B.4`

- **Vietnam removes third top leader in two months, reshuffles cadres** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-05-20 | [URL](https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-removes-third-top-leader-in-two-months-reshuffles-cadres/2092648/)  
  Reuters described upheaval, infighting, and a chilling effect on bureaucracy from the anti-graft campaign. This is negative evidence for clean technocratic staffing, because personnel moves were politically driven and destabilizing.  
  `Question IDs: 7B.5, 7B.3`

- **Vietnam's top leader Trọng dies at 80, party says** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-07-19 | [URL](https://theprint.in/world/vietnams-top-leader-trong-dies-at-80-party-says/2181868/)  
  Reuters said Trọng’s anti-corruption campaign tightened state control and used probes to consolidate party discipline. That supports a reading of merit/discipline rhetoric mixed with political loyalty enforcement, not a clean professional appointment system.  
  `Question IDs: 7B.5, 7B.3, 7B.4`

- **Explainer: Communist-run Vietnam's graft campaign** | Reuters via Yahoo | 2024-08-26 | [URL](https://www.yahoo.com/news/explainer-communist-run-vietnams-graft-090057091.html)  
  Reuters described the anti-graft campaign as real but politically disruptive, with repeated reshuffles and uncertainty. This is mixed evidence: it suggests a purge of bad actors, but also shows that personnel management was entangled with internal power struggles.  
  `Question IDs: 7B.5, 7B.4`

**Search Gap**
- I did not find direct 2024 evidence that Trọng appointed family members, personal cronies, donors, or business associates into top offices.
- I also did not find a credible source mapping his close personal network into cabinet, party, or regulatory appointments.
- The best-supported conclusion is therefore indirect: the system showed some technocratic and anti-corruption constraints, but it was still party-controlled, opaque, and politically disruptive rather than clearly meritocratic.
